svg.aria-label: Ask the Filings: ingestion downloads 10-K filing HTML from SEC EDGAR, cleans it to text with flattened tables, cuts section-aware chunks of about 400 words, embeds them locally with bge-small and stores them in Postgres with pgvector and a full-text index. Each question runs dense and sparse retrieval, fuses the results with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and asks Gemini for JSON with whether it is answerable, the answer and citation ids, returning a cited answer or 'not in the filings'.

Each question runs dense and sparse retrieval, fuses the results with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and asks Gemini for JSON with whether it is answerable, the answer and citation ids, returning a cited answer or 'not in the filings'.

g.text: both indexes queried for every question
